build_gemma_feed_forward: build a Gemma feed-forward layer with GEGLU activation from embedding and hidden dimensions
build_gemma_attention: build a Gemma self-attention layer with RoPE embeddings and optional single KV head from config
build_gemma_transformer_block: build a Gemma transformer decoder block with RMS normalization and residual connections from config
create_gemma_transformer: create a Gemma transformer model from configuration with shared embedding and side-input effects
load_gemma_pretrained: load a Gemma transformer from an official Flax checkpoint with parameter mapping and axis renaming
